description: This file contains functions for formatting and fetching time range data, including building time range strings, formatting date endpoints, and making API calls to retrieve time range data with optional shifts. It is part of the superset-ui-core package, specifically related to time comparison features.

methods.name: buildTimeRangeString
methods.description: Constructs a string representing a time range from 'since' and 'until' timestamps.

methods.name: formatDateEndpoint
methods.description: Formats a date string by removing the time component or replacing with infinity symbols based on position.

methods.name: formatTimeRange
methods.description: Formats a time range string into a human-readable comparison format with placeholders.

methods.name: formatTimeRangeComparison
methods.description: Formats two time ranges into a comparison string with placeholders.

methods.name: fetchTimeRange
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches time range data from an API, with optional shifts, and formats the response.
